description: READ-ONLY / UNSIGNED: build an unsigned DeFi transaction payload (supply, redeem, borrow, repay, claim) or quote LP amounts (quote_lp) via the official Binance Web3 DeFi API. Never signs, never broadcasts, never touches private keys — returns unsigned contract calldata (and optional simulation result) for wallet signing or CLI inspection.

amount.description: Token amount in human units or base units (required for supply|redeem|borrow|repay|quote_lp).

chainId.description: Optional chain slug or chainId (e.g. ethereum, bnb, arbitrum, base, polygon, optimism, avalanche, linea, sonic, solana).

investmentId.description: Binance Web3 DeFi investmentId (from read_defi scope=investments).

simulate.description: When true (default), also runs Binance Web3 DeFi transaction simulation on the unsigned payload.

slippageBps.description: Optional slippage tolerance in basis points (default 50 = 0.5%).

tokenAddress.description: Optional input/output token contract address (defaults to investment primary token).

walletAddress.description: User wallet address (0x... for EVM or base58 for Solana). Required for supply|redeem|borrow|repay|claim.

name: build_defi_tx
title: Build or quote unsigned DeFi transaction
